systems.description: Handles play selection UI and picks offensive/defensive plays.
Snaps the ball and starts the play.
Moves receivers and defenders along waypoints.
Moves the ball carrier based on player input and simple constraints.
Simple AI to chase ball carrier and defend zones/routes.
Detects collisions between defenders and ball carrier and ends the play.
Updates down, distance, yardline, and handles turnovers.
Handles touchdowns, field goals, extra points, and final outcome.
